# Chapter 13 — 门开着呢 (The Door Is Open)

**Pinyin:** Mén kāi zhe ne  
**Source:** *HSK Standard Course 2*, printed pages 97–104 (source image pages 117–124).

## New Words

| No. | Chinese | Pinyin | English | Source |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 着 | zhe | particle used after a verb to indicate a continuing state | p. 98 |
| 2 | 手 | shǒu | n. hand | p. 98 |
| 3 | 拿 | ná | v. to hold; to take; to bring | p. 98 |
| 4 | 铅笔 | qiānbǐ | n. pencil | p. 98 |
| 5 | 班 | bān | n. class; grade; team | p. 99 |
| 6 | 长 | zhǎng | v. to grow; to develop | p. 99 |
| 7 | 笑 | xiào | v. to smile; to laugh | p. 99 |
| 8 | 宾馆 | bīnguǎn | n. hotel | p. 99 |
| 9 | 一直 | yìzhí | adv. straight; all along | p. 99 |
| 10 | 往 | wǎng | prep. toward(s) | p. 99 |
| 11 | 路口 | lùkǒu | n. crossing; crossroads | p. 99 |

The numbered New Words list has eleven entries and no numbered subentries. The p. 97 warm-up separately practices **铅笔、手、宾馆、拿、眼睛、路口** and asks learners to add objects to verbs; these are activity prompts, not additional numbered entries.

## Proper Names

| Chinese | Pinyin | English / note | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 杨笑笑 | Yáng Xiàoxiào | Yang Xiaoxiao; a person's name | p. 98 |

## Unique Hanzi in New Words

Distinct characters in the eleven numbered New Words entries, listed once in order of first appearance: **着、手、拿、铅、笔、班、长、笑、宾、馆、一、直、往、路、口** (15 characters).

## Characters

The Characters section on printed p. 103 teaches two radicals, separately from the New Words list:

- **斤** (斤字旁): generally related to axes and cutting or whittling; examples **新** (xīn, new) and **所** (suǒ, place).
- **页** (页字旁): generally related to the human head or face; examples **颜** (yán, face; look) and **须** (xū, beard; mustache).
